title.zh: 一天的节奏，由我们自己决定
title.en: The rhythm of the day, decided by you

text.zh: 从清晨的第一杯茶到夜晚的最后一盏灯，蔚印象把时间还给你。
text.en: From the first cup of tea in the morning to the last lamp at night — Wei Impression gives your time back to you.

description.zh: 本地食材，慢火烹饪。义乌的麦饼、东河的杨梅、现磨的豆浆——用一餐早饭，认识这座城市。
description.en: Local ingredients, cooked slowly. Yiwu wheat cakes, Donghe bayberries, freshly ground soy milk — meet the city over breakfast.

details.zh: 每日现做 · 本地风味

description.zh: 大堂书廊的一角，茶烟升起。一壶明前绿茶，几枚手作点心，是忙碌一天里最值得虚度的两小时。
description.en: In a corner of the reading lounge, steam rises from a pot of pre-Qingming green tea. Handmade pastries beside it — the most worthwhile two hours of a busy day.

details.zh: 精选明前绿茶 · 本地茶席
手作点心 · 每日更换

description.zh: 我们把睡眠当作一项工程：全屋遮光、静音隔断、符合人体工学的床垫、可选的助眠香氛。夜是完整的。
description.en: Sleep, treated as a craft: total blackout, silent walls, ergonomic mattresses, optional calming scents. The night stays whole.

details.zh: 长绒棉寝具 · 可选软硬枕

description.zh: 24 小时前台与管家服务，安静地站在你需要的地方：清晨的行李、深夜的热水、临行前的城市路线。
description.en: A 24-hour front desk and butler service, quietly present where you need it: luggage at dawn, warm water at midnight, a city route before departure.

details.zh: 行李寄存 · 叫醒服务
AI 语音管家随时应答

description.zh: 大堂是安静的书廊，庭院是露天的客厅，顶层露台收藏义乌的天际线。公共空间的设计原则只有一个：让人愿意留下来。
description.en: The lobby is a quiet reading lounge; the courtyard, an open-air living room; the rooftop terrace, a collector of Yiwu's skyline. One principle guides all public spaces: make people want to stay.

details.zh: 大堂书廊 · 精选设计书刊
顶层露台 · 天际线酒廊
